Hindus believe that the name resonates with the divine powers of success and prosperity and is believed to bring positive energies and blessings.

vedic_reference.note: The name Shrey is derived from the Sanskrit word श्रेष्ठ (shreṣṭh), which means 'excellent', 'best', or 'prosperous'. In Vedic texts, this term is used to describe a person who is considered superior, accomplished, or prosperous.

historical_references.reference: Shreyaschaturthi is a significant day in the Hindu lunisolar calendar, marking the anniversary of the death of sage Shukacharya, who is believed to have attained moksha (liberation) on this day. This day is also called Vyasapithrudu samaradhane Divasam in Andhra Pradesh, India. The date falls on the Chaturthi (fourth day) of the bright fortnight of the Hindu month of Magha (January-February).
